challenger.fill_eligibility: market event timestamp strictly after POST and locally received before decision
challenger.purpose: replace frozen pre-entry flow-rate capital retention with causally refreshed resting-order flow freshness; research-only, no live mutation

high_probability_case.interpretation: The only later compatible print cleared displayed queue but never own size. A 20-second receive-time stale-hazard replay would have recycled this order before the late queue-only print without forfeiting a fill in the observed window.

interpretation.material_result: Across every A/B/C/D/E arm in this exact prospective window, refreshing resting-order hazard by receive-time staleness would have reduced reserved capital-time by roughly 57.8%-66.7% while forfeiting zero fills relative to the observed static-TTL path. This is capital-efficiency evidence, not alpha or fill-PnL evidence.
limits: the five policy arms share underlying market opportunities and are not independent samples
no fills occurred in either static or replayed path, so fill-conditioned PnL is unchanged
the 20-second staleness threshold is a bounded challenger parameter, not a promoted production setting
next_gate: run the refreshed-hazard policy prospectively on independent windows
measure actual fill-rate delta and missed-fill rate versus incumbent static hazard
measure filled notional per capital-hour and executable 45s/60s/300s markout
require positive fill-conditioned net PnL under 1x/1.5x/2x cost stress before promotion
